title: Same NQ breakout, rules untouched, run on ES, gold and silver: +20%, +9%, -54% and -98%
author: person-person12
selftext:
A lot of ppl find something that works on NQ and assume it carries over to ES or gold, since its all just price on a chart. I had a plain 20 candle breakout I built for NQ in [Agenticks](https://www.agenticks.ca/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=autopilot&utm_content=ai_trading), so I ran the exact same rules on ES, gold and silver without changing a single setting.

15m candles, January 2021 to the end of September 2026, $100k account, one contract, commission and slippage charged on every fill.

**NQ:** 3,654 trades, 37.6% win rate, profit factor 1.01, +19.6%, max drawdown 54.7%

**ES:** 3,547 trades, 37.7% win rate, profit factor 1.01, +8.5%, max drawdown 26.4%

**Gold:** 3,742 trades, 36.0% win rate, profit factor 0.96, **-53.8%**, max drawdown 84.4%

**Silver:** 954 trades, 35.0% win rate, profit factor 0.70, **-98.1%**, and the $100k was down to $1,908 by August 2022

The win rate barely moved across all four, 35 to 38% every time, so the difference is almost entirely in how big the losers got compared to the winners on each market.

Even the NQ version isnt something id trade, a 1.01 profit factor with a 54.7% drawdown is breakeven with a lot of pain attached, and ES made less than half as much with **half the drawdown**.
